mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role) AS role_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu) AS menu_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_login_log WHERE login_time >= #{todayStart} AND status = 1) AS today_login_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_oper_log WHERE oper_time >= #{todayStart}) AS today_oper_count

SELECT CAST(login_time AS DATE) AS login_date, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS fail FROM sys_login_log WHERE login_time >= #{begin} GROUP BY CAST(login_time AS DATE)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount * o.exchange_rate), 0) FROM scm_order o WHERE o.kind = #{kind} AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL', 'COMPLETED', 'CLOSED') AND o.order_date >= #{begin} AND o.order_date <= #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_order o WHERE o.kind = #{kind} AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.amount - b.settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill b WHERE b.kind = #{kind}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_work_order w WHERE w.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED')
